## Summary
Fixes #6705

The `/review` command was failing with a `model_not_found` error because it was trying to use `gpt-5-codex` which no longer exists.

## Changes
- Updated `OPENAI_DEFAULT_REVIEW_MODEL` from `gpt-5-codex` to `gpt-5.1-codex`
- Updated documentation comment to reflect the new default model
- Removed unused `GPT_5_CODEX_MEDIUM_MODEL` constant

## Test Plan
- [x] Verified the model name change matches the available model
- [x] Updated relevant documentation comments
- [x] Test `/review` command with the new default model

## Related Issue
Resolves the error reported in #6705 where users on Pro subscription were seeing:
```
The requested model 'gpt-5-codex' does not exist.
```

items.body:
Some build tools, such as Elixir’s Mix, open a local listening socket to coordinate work across multiple worker processes. Allowing network-inbound on localhost enables this behavior while preserving the intended threat model, since it only permits connections from the same machine. Any process able to connect over loopback already has full local execution privileges.

This commit does not allow network-outbound on purpose, as it would effectively allow the command to communicate with other services which may not be sandboxed.

See https://github.com/openai/codex/issues/6737.
items.title: Allow seatbelt binding/listening on local addresses

items.body:
## Summary
This pull request adds comprehensive support for running OpenAI Codex on Android devices via the Termux environment. Previously, OpenAI Codex did not support Termux, limiting its usability on Android devices.

## Key Changes
- **Initial Android Platform Support**: Added Android as a supported target platform in the Codex CLI
- **Dependency Management**: Gated clipboard dependency (`arboard`) that's not available on Android to prevent build failures
- **Build System**: Added Termux-compatible build workflow with GitHub Actions
- **OpenSSL Support**: Enabled vendored OpenSSL for Android builds to resolve compilation issues
- **Android NDK Integration**: 
  - Added NDK download validation and caching
  - Created compiler symlinks for NDK compatibility
  - Fixed working directory issues in NDK extraction
- **CI/CD Improvements**: Fixed test timeouts and build issues specific to Termux environments
- **Syntax Fixes**: Resolved shell syntax errors in build scripts

## Test Plan
- [x] Verify Codex builds successfully on Android/Termux environment
- [x] Test basic Codex functionality (commands, interactions) on Termux
- [x] Validate GitHub Actions workflow runs correctly for Android builds
- [x] Ensure existing functionality remains unaffected on other platforms

## Files Changed
- `.github/workflows/termux-build.yml`: Added Android build workflow
- `codex-rs/tui/Cargo.toml`: Added Android-specific dependency gating
- `codex-rs/core/Cargo.toml`: Added OpenSSL vendoring for Android
- Various build and configuration files for Android NDK support

## Platform Support
This change enables Codex to run on:
- Android devices with Termux installed
- ARM64 and x86_64 Android architectures
- Android API level 21+

## References
Resolves the gap where Codex was previously unavailable on Android platforms. This implementation follows similar patterns used in other Rust tools that support Termux environments.
